title: AI Market Volatility Following US Midterm Elections
body_md:
**TL;DR**

- Tech stocks and the Nasdaq plunged following Democratic midterm election victories.
- Political backlash against data center expansion threatens AI infrastructure growth.
- OpenAI and Perplexity are expanding agentic AI capabilities for work and science.
- Anthropic maintains an ad-free stance for Claude amid industry-wide monetization shifts.

The AI sector is facing significant market turbulence as rising concerns over politics and AI regulation impact investor confidence. The tech-heavy Nasdaq experienced a sharp decline following the midterm elections, driven by fears that a Democratic-controlled Congress will implement stricter oversight and curb the construction of data centers. Industry leaders acknowledge that public hostility toward infrastructure expansion has become a major hurdle for future AI development.

Despite the regulatory headwinds, innovation continues in the agentic AI space. OpenAI is advancing scientific research with its new BioBasicsBench and has committed to greater transparency regarding data center projects. Meanwhile, Perplexity is challenging incumbents with new work-focused AI agents, and Anthropic continues to differentiate its Claude platform by resisting the industry trend of integrating advertisements into chatbots.
